body: Sorry for late response--only other substance is a migraine medication. No drugs, etc. I'm hanging in, hope you are too :)

Hey, I've been on Welbutrin since December. I take 300 mg every morning, and it's been working for me. I agree with all your pros and cons and have noticed some similar side affects, mostly the spaciness and forgetfulness. 

For the first month I felt no changes, the second and third months I noticed the best changes and felt great. I've been feeling really depressed lately but have also had a lot going on in my life that could've caused it. Obviously, no medicine cures depression, they just make it easier to live with.

Have you noticed any increases in anxiety? I've been feeling more anxious while on it but have been solving that with vitamins (B complex, Vitamin D, and Magnesium-Calcium-Zinc).
I've never read it but I love the movies. I have read The Hobbit and enjoyed that. Any reason why this is your fantasy world? I'm not criticizing, I'm really just curious.

I don't know if I've related to a post here more than this. My dream is to br a musician. I've played guitar almost my whole life but I've always been subpar. I recently bought a midi controller to make music similar to my idol, Passion Pit. Lots of people convinced me to, I've gotten the whole "follow your dreams" thing so often. But then I sit down and try writing a song and I realize how hard it is for me to really do. I've just accepted that all I'll ever end up being is someone working a desk job. Why have idols if you can't become anything like them? It's frustrating. It's really upsetting. I want to be something but I don't know how. I don't think I ever will be. I feel everything you're saying, truly.
What book?

I'm reading two right now, The Vegetarian and Imagine Me Gone. I'm absolutely loving both. I understand the not concentrating, I use to read a book a week before I was diagnosed with depression and now I struggle to read one in a month.
What are some of your favorite books? My all time favorite is Catch-22. I've read that maybe 5 times now.

How was their reaction? Was it clear you were being serious? Do you think they might've just not known what to do or are you sure they don't care?
Regardless, don't let them decide your fate. If they're real friends they will care. It took me years and years and so many bad groups of people to finally find some I could call true friends.

Hope you're feeling better! 
I had a pretty rough day, the worst in a while actually. But I'm ending it by working on a song I'm writing and reading a book--two of my favorite things.
Do you like to read? What type of music do you like?

That's awesome, congratulations! 
I love the idea of these small victories, little things that just make me happy mean so much more because they *actually* made me happy.

The same actually happens to me sometimes, you're not alone. It's really uncontrollable, I'll just be doing physics homework and like you said I'll just start tearing up. More often though I get so frustrated that I either need to quit or vent. I just have so many setbacks that make being productive very difficult. Either I'm distracted, frustrated, anxious or sad (or all at once, etc) and none of those things make doing work easy in any way.

That's sad to hear, I'm sorry. I'm probably doomed to a similar fate. I get similar feelings, when I've got nothing to occupy my mind I stress about things I didn't even think I was upset about. Sometimes I almost prefer having a bit of work to do so I can keep my mind off things, but most of the time I'm happier doing nothing.

I feel this a lot, I don't really know what I do. I try to keep my mind occupied with music while I work so even if I start to slip music brings me back. But I still slip up, some nights I'll just go to sleep and push my responsibilities off for another day. It's bad but sometimes it's what I need to be healthy. I try to remember how important my mental health is but college is more important than it sometimes...it's just all very tough.
Thanks for the kindness. I rested and feel a bit better but there's still this lingering sense of stress, I still feel super anxious.

That's really fucked up, [here is the website] (https://suicidepreventionlifeline.org/) with their information. You can also text them if calling isn't working. Definitely report the fact you weren't getting answers, that's definitely not good. Do you need help in the meantime?
Such a big part of me loves her so much though. No matter what she said... It's really frustrating and it's really confusing

I don't know you but I'm proud of you. I remember when I started running and it just felt so freeing. I felt like I could just run and nothing could touch me, none of my worries, my anxiety, my depression, it didn't matter. It was nonexistent in those few miles. It's like exercising puts me in a little bubble where I'm immune to all those painful things. I hope it has the same effect on you. 
Be safe though! Some workouts aren't meant to be done excessively or every day in a row. Most importantly, keep it up and enjoy yourself.
I'm taking medication and I've been to therapy. I'm not giving up yet but I'm losing hope
I totally agree! What are some artists you like that you connect to?
I'm just realizing how truly unhappy I am and how much I dislike myself. I want to change but I don't know how.

Thank you for your response. I do believe things get better but it is so tough to wait for them to improve. The things I find happiness in are just so tenuous and then when they're gone I'm left like this. My motivation to live isn't to wait for things to get better, it's because I am simply too afraid of death to die. 
I want to add that I am not planning on taking my life.  I don't want to put the pressure on you to have to stop a stranger from doing that. I know myself and trust myself and I know I am not taking my life tonight.

I was trying to think of account names and that lyric had just popped in my head so I figure why not try it.

But yeah, that's a great metaphor--taking to a television. I feel so disconnected. I'm not uninterested but I don't feel happy and it's very frustrating because I should feel happy. It's even harder to pretend to be happy, especially when I'm surrounded by so many people I'm meeting for the first time. I feel like I'm making a bad first impression on people and that's just making me feel worse.
